source.name: US Department of Labor, Office of Foreign Labor Certification — LCA Disclosure Data FY2026 Q1
source.what_each_row_is: An employer's legal attestation of the wage it will pay for one named role at one named worksite.

method: omega-squared, all factors scored on one identical set of rows

by_employer_min_15.employer: FIDELITY TECHNOLOGY GROUP, LLC D/B/A FIDELITY INVESTMENTS

methodology_notes: Hourly filings are annualised at 2080 hours per year.
WAGE_RATE_OF_PAY_FROM is the bottom of the attested range — the figure the employer is legally bound to meet. It is a floor, not a midpoint.
Seniority is inferred from the employer's own job title text, not from any standardised level. 'unlabelled' means the title carried no seniority word.
Manager and director titles are a separate track from the individual contributor ladder; they are reported but are not a rung above 'staff'.
These are base wages. Equity and bonus are not part of an LCA attestation, so these figures are not comparable to survey numbers that include them.
H-1B filings skew toward larger employers, tech-dense metros, and roles companies choose to sponsor. This is not a sample of all US software jobs.
All personal columns in the source file are discarded on read.
